turns.content: Hi — I’m looking at Section 4 of the Master Services Agreement, specifically 4.2 and the rollover provision. Clara sent her notice on March 14, requesting unused retainer hours be carried into Q2. I’ve counted the business days from March 14 through March 31, excluding weekends, and I get 12 business days. Section 4.2 requires at least 10 business days’ notice before quarter close. 12 is comfortably above that, so my read is that her notice is timely. Can you confirm that’s sound based on the contract language?
Let me pull up the agreement and Clara's notice to check this against the actual language.

Right — and just to be thorough, I want to check my understanding of the rollover itself. Section 4.2 says "unused retainer hours" can carry forward. Our retainer blends design and strategy into one monthly pool — it's not split out. So "unused retainer hours" would mean whatever's left in that combined pool, correct? Or does the wording imply something narrower that I'm missing?
Good instinct to double-check both pieces — let me actually pull the agreement text before confirming anything.

Okay — so if the blended pool is what “unused retainer hours” refers to, that makes sense. But I want to be careful: Section 4.2 doesn’t explicitly say the pool can be combined across service types. It just says “unused retainer hours.” Does the agreement define retainer hours anywhere else that would settle this?
You're right to push on that — let me actually check the document rather than work from memory.

Right. And on the cap — Section 4.2 says rollover hours used in Q2 stay at the 20-hour maximum, right? Same limit as Q1. Also, Section 4.4 mentions ad-hoc hours can't roll over. But we have some out-of-scope work billed hourly this quarter — does 4.4 clearly bar those from the rollover, or is there room to argue?
Let me actually search for the agreement so I can stop guessing — I want to read 4.2 and 4.4 verbatim before confirming any of this.

Okay — and on the rate question. Section 4.3 says rolled-over hours get billed at the "prevailing rate" in the quarter they're used. So if Clara uses those Q1 hours in Q2, do I apply Q2's rate, or does the original Q1 rate from when they were accrued lock in? I need to know before I run reconciliation.
